statements.action_statement: Maintainer decision 2026-10-23: wait for Ubuntu to publish a grub2 build whose SBAT carries grub,6, then rebuild (make build), re-scan (make vulns) and re-test (make e2e). The grub generation is never raised by hand. Until then Secure Boot boots fail on PCs that applied SbatLevel 2025112400; documented in docs/SECURE_BOOT.md.

Maintainer decision 2026-10-23: wait for Ubuntu to publish a shim-signed build signed by the Microsoft UEFI CA 2023, then rebuild, re-scan and re-test. Until then Secure Boot boots fail on PCs whose db trusts only the 2023 CA; documented in docs/SECURE_BOOT.md.
